Resolves #21259

The engine e2e tier's duration table is rebuilt from dev's latest full run, so its 14 shards balance again. The table listed 194 of the tier's 223 spec files. The 29 added since its last rebuild counted as the median, and the time-balanced split drifted until pull-request shards reached the 300 s ceiling with every test passed. Data file only; `FULL_SHARDS`, the ceiling and the CLI are unchanged.

Evidence: L2 (table regenerated and diffed, per-shard times computed, selection unit spec run) -> L3 required (#21259's post-merge AC reads the next 20 pull-request runs).
